SELECT u.*, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name) FROM user_role ur JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id) AS roleName FROM `user` u
AND u.user_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userNo}, '%')
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.user_id
